reviews.text: Thank you so much for your trust and for this wonderful review. We are always happy to be able to support you and your companion 🐾 …

I've been going to this clinic for over 10 years and I still go there even after moving 30 minutes away by car. Dr. Milhet has always given excellent advice regarding my 6-7 cats who have been treated there. It's a veterinary clinic that has always been more expensive, but it has saved me money in the long run thanks to the veterinarians' extensive knowledge. I'm a little disappointed about the clinic being bought by a large company, but it seems that's what's happening in Quebec right now (clinics being bought by multinationals).

I had very good experiences with Drs. Lemay and Léger, and slightly less so with the other veterinarian. During my cat's follow-up appointments, she was treated with competence and compassion, and the receptionists, technicians, and veterinarians were very helpful in providing advice and answering my questions.

Furthermore, I was able to be with my cat during her final days and take all the time I needed.
My only reservation is that they seem to belong to a large chain, which could be partly responsible for the soaring veterinary costs. If you have the time and energy to do your research, you might find a cheaper option elsewhere, but other than that, I would recommend this clinic.

The clinic is in the well vicinity of plateau mont royal. The staff is very friendly and the Stella (dog) is always happy to visit the vet:).  Great vet service as well from the doctors. We got the necessary vaccination done this time around
It warms our hearts to know you enjoyed your visit. Our priority is always the health and well-being of your four-legged companions 🐶🐱 …
Skip this place. This is a big business that prioritizes profit over pets and their owners. If you do want to give it a shot, avoid Dr. Milhet at all costs.

Unreasonably long wait time and bill came out outrageously high. I did not have a good experience with the doctor as he talks more than he listens. He also keeps on adding and pressuring me to take on extra services & products. I will be changing vet and I do not recommend this place. Very disappointing experience.
We are dedicated to making your experience perfect, Ms. Wayland. Thank you for this review!
We are pleased to know that you enjoyed your experience with us, we look forward to seeing you again!

I went to this clinic for several years and was very satisfied with the service. About two years ago, I switched veterinarians to Dr. Milhet, and I didn't like his service. I felt he did everything he could to increase my bill and wasn't very transparent about the prices of each service. I didn't feel he was doing what was best for my pet, and the prices were particularly high. I changed veterinary clinics.
We are pleased to see that our service is receiving positive feedback. Listening to our clients and patients is a priority for us.
I appreciated their gentle approach, both for the general examination and the vaccinations. The vet and his assistant took the necessary time to avoid startling my 3-month-old puppy.
Thank you for your trust 💐 We are proud to contribute to the health and happiness of your little companions 🐶🐾 …

We were rather disappointed with our experience. In two visits, we faced long wait times and received the wrong vaccine. Furthermore, we didn't find the vet's service or advice particularly warm or helpful. We decided to go to a different clinic.
Thank you for your trust 💐 We are proud to contribute to the health and happiness of your little companions 🐶🐾 Never hesitate to contact us if you need anything. …

Thank you for rating your experience at the clinic. Our priority is to provide exceptional service. If you feel the service you received could be improved, we sincerely apologize and hope you will give us a second chance to prove we can exceed your expectations.

Sadly, a very bad experience at the Plateau Mont-Royal branch. We had been customers for several years, but unfortunately, we will now be going elsewhere. What was supposed to be a simple visit to pick up tick medication and have a blood sample taken from Ollie's paw turned into a traumatic experience for him—and for us too.

Our little 6-pound Yorkie, Ollie, was bitten three to five times. The technician tried several times to draw blood from his paw, then from his neck, without success. With each attempt, Ollie cried out in pain. Finally, a veterinarian was called and managed to draw the blood. Needless to say, we won't be going back.
Thank you so much for your review! ⭐ The entire team appreciates your trust and is delighted to have contributed to your pet's well-being. We look forward to seeing you again soon at the clinic!

Thank you so much for the 5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The whole team is delighted to have been able to take care of your pet.
Dr. Léger is great, highly recommend.
Excellent service, competent veterinarian and technicians.
Thank you for entrusting your pet to us. We love what we do and are delighted that this is reflected in your experience.

We work tirelessly to provide exceptional service to all animals and their owners. Please let us know how we can exceed your expectations! Don't hesitate to give us another chance to prove that your satisfaction is our priority.
Thank you for the 5-star rating and your positive feedback! It's an honor to care for your pets and share these important moments with you. See you soon!
I hadn't yet posted a comment, even though my dog ​​is in heaven, they were the best vets ever!
The lady at the desk is lovely, however if you go there for basic vaccines, the vet might pressure you to buy food or services.

Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're delighted to hear you had a great experience with us. Taking care of your pets is our priority, and we're happy to contribute to their well-being. See you soon! 🐶🤗 …

Terrific and reassuring! Thorough and such competent staff from Sylvie at Reception, Calina the Vet Technician and Vet Dr. Jean-Paul Milhet are there to support the health of your pet with such professionalism and personability (and Dr. Milhet's endearing quirky personality! ;) Arrive stressed, leave totally at ease with generous explanation; all the necessary tests and/or supplies (no over selling); and -- a very happy, comforted pet ... with a plan. Thank you so much for the gold-star service and knowledge!

The vets here are very nice and efficient, and the people at the desk are lovely and helpful. Any questions we have, they reply nicely and care about our dog, so we're super happy about this vet clinic ❤️
Excellent service
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We are honored to be a part of your pet's life and to support you on their health journey. We look forward to seeing you again!
Thank you for your fantastic review! See you soon :)

I am very disappointed with my experience at this veterinary clinic. From the moment I arrived, the reception was far from welcoming: the receptionist was rude, and one of the attendants seemed constantly judgmental, even making hateful comments. This made me extremely uncomfortable. For an establishment where one expects kindness and professionalism, it was quite the opposite. I expected to be treated with respect and compassion, but unfortunately, that was not the case here. When a bill comes to 1800, is it really necessary to add insult to injury?
Thank you for your encouragement and trust. We are happy to know that you enjoyed your experience with us, and we look forward to seeing you again!

A little annual routine. As always, impeccable service. Super friendly staff. An exceptional vet; my little Toukie barely even noticed his vaccination. Dr. Malaury is exceptionally kind and gentle with my little dog. Thank you, it's a real pleasure to be so well cared for by such attentive people.
Thank you for your review! We do our best to provide the best care that each of our clients and their furry friends needs and deserves. We hope to see you again soon. ⭐️
It's a pleasure to read your feedback! We strive to provide you with 5-star service. 🙏 …

A YEAR AGO, I HAD THE GREAT MISFORTUNE OF BEING SERVED BY DR. CAROLINE LEGER FOR THE EUTHANASIA OF MY LITTLE CHIWAWA MIX (15 YEARS OLD) WHO WAS ALREADY UNCONDITIONAL WHEN I ARRIVED AT THE CLINIC; My little dog suffered a tragic and horribly painful end from the very first injection. I also screamed at the vet (WHAT ARE YOU DOING?!), myself yelling in pain, just like my little one. I have never, ever had such a horrible experience with a vet! With my two other dogs and one cat, I have always been very well cared for by other vets, especially Dr. Michelle Lemay. I absolutely do not recommend her.
We're delighted to hear you received outstanding service, Mathieu. Please don't hesitate to come back and see us! 😊 …
Hello, we are sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations. Please feel free to let us know what we can do to improve.
